// Factory internal Pi 5 retained; no optional external computer is required.
// Mechanical candidate; actual mounting interfaces are declared below.
Robot mount_rosbot_a3_reverse_depth_mapping {
    intent "Panoramic A3 mapping with rear depth observation"

    Mecanum_four_wheel chassis(ref = "husarion_rosbot_xl_mecanum_chassis")
    Mecanum wheel_front_left(ref = "husarion_rosbot_xl_mecanum_wheel_front_left", glue = (0.085000000010, 0.1, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_front_right(ref = "husarion_rosbot_xl_mecanum_wheel_front_right", glue = (0.085000000010, -0.1, 0, 0, -1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_left(ref = "husarion_rosbot_xl_mecanum_wheel_rear_left", glue = (-0.085000000010, 0.1, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_right(ref = "husarion_rosbot_xl_mecanum_wheel_rear_right", glue = (-0.085000000010, -0.1, 0, 0, -1, 0))

    Mount device1_scanner_mount(ref = "robotdsl_rosbot_rplidar_open_crown", on = @core/chassis, at = "sight_lidar_spider", by = "under_holes")

    Lidar device1_scanner(ref = "husarion_rplidar_a3m1", on = @core/device1_scanner_mount, at = "scanner_holes", by = "mounting_holes")

    Mount device2_support(ref = "robotdsl_rosbot_d435_rear_fork", on = @core/chassis, at = "rear_camera_pair", by = "under_holes")

    RGBD device2_sensor(ref = "realsense_d435", on = @core/device2_support, at = "sensor_holes", by = "rear_holes")
}

// Factory internal Pi 5 retained; no optional external computer is required.

Robot mount_rosbot_rgb_floor_inspection {
    intent "Forward RGB context with downward close-range surface inspection"

    Mecanum_four_wheel chassis(ref = "husarion_rosbot_xl_mecanum_chassis")
    Mecanum wheel_front_left(ref = "husarion_rosbot_xl_mecanum_wheel_front_left", glue = (0.085000000010, 0.1, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_front_right(ref = "husarion_rosbot_xl_mecanum_wheel_front_right", glue = (0.085000000010, -0.1, 0, 0, -1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_left(ref = "husarion_rosbot_xl_mecanum_wheel_rear_left", glue = (-0.085000000010, 0.1, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_right(ref = "husarion_rosbot_xl_mecanum_wheel_rear_right", glue = (-0.085000000010, -0.1, 0, 0, -1, 0))

    Mount device1_support(ref = "robotdsl_rosbot_camera3_nose_cage", on = @core/chassis, at = "v3_front_left_sensor", by = "under_holes")

    Camera device1_sensor(ref = "raspberry_pi_camera_module_3", on = @core/device1_support, at = "sensor_holes", by = "camera_pcb_holes")

    Mount device2_support(ref = "robotdsl_rosbot_d405_inspection_arm", on = @core/chassis, at = "sight_camera_rosbot", by = "under_holes")

    RGBD device2_sensor(ref = "realsense_d405", on = @core/device2_support, at = "sensor_holes", by = "tripod_hole")
}

// Mechanical design candidate; consult recorded geometry/access/load gates. Electrical, control and power systems are not completed by this example.
// Compute: added_pi5
Robot mount_v3_strafer_compute_sonar {
    intent "Rear-left Pi5 and front short-range ultrasonic sensor"

    Mecanum_four_wheel chassis(ref = "gobilda_strafer_chassis_kit_104mm")

    // The Strafer kit includes these four motors; retained 1:1 miter gears drive its wheel shafts.
    Motor motor_front_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, 0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0))
    Motor motor_front_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, -0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0))
    Motor motor_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, 0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0))
    Motor motor_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, -0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_front_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_front_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (-0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (-0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))

    Mount compute_mount(ref = "robotdsl_mount_v3_compute_strafer", on = @core/chassis, at = "compute_strafer_pi5", by = "under_holes")

    Attachment computer(ref = "raspberry_pi_5_8gb", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes")

    Mount sensor_mount(ref = "robotdsl_mount_v3_sensor_strafer_mb1010", on = @core/chassis, at = "v3_front_ultrasonic", by = "under_holes")

    Ultrasonic front_sensor(ref = "maxbotix_mb1010_lv_maxsonar_ez1", on = @core/sensor_mount, at = "sensor_holes", by = "mounting_holes")
}

    Standard wheel_right(ref = "pololu_wheel_70x8mm", glue = (0, -0.0704, 0, 0, -1, 0))

    Caster caster(ref = "pololu_romi_ball_caster", glue = (-0.064, 0, -0.0223, 0, 0, -1))

    Lidar3D lidar(ref = "unitree_4d_lidar_l2", glue = (-0.03, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1))

}

// A Hiwonder ROSOrin as its Standard Kit builds it: the body on four 80 mm mecanum wheels, with the kit's LiDAR
// on the top deck and its depth camera on the plate under the deck's front. The kit is sold without a computer.
Robot rosorin {
    intent "Hiwonder ROSOrin mecanum base with its LiDAR and depth camera"

    Mecanum_four_wheel chassis(ref = "hiwonder_rosorin_chassis")

    // The kit's motors, each on its bracket at a wheel.
    Motor motor_front_left(ref = "hiwonder_520_gearmotor_90_12v", glue = (0.0908915, 0.0619651, 0.0170888, 0, 1, 0))
    Motor motor_front_right(ref = "hiwonder_520_gearmotor_90_12v", glue = (0.0908915, -0.0618171, 0.0170888, 0, -1, 0))
    Motor motor_rear_left(ref = "hiwonder_520_gearmotor_90_12v", glue = (-0.08064, 0.0619618, 0.0167005, 0, 1, 0))
    Motor motor_rear_right(ref = "hiwonder_520_gearmotor_90_12v", glue = (-0.08064, -0.0618128, 0.0167005, 0, -1, 0))

    Mecanum wheel_front_left(ref = "hiwonder_mecanum_wheel_80mm_fl_rr", glue = (0.091, 0.0871, 0.0171, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_front_right(ref = "hiwonder_mecanum_wheel_80mm_fr_rl", glue = (0.091, -0.0871, 0.0171, 0, -1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_left(ref = "hiwonder_mecanum_wheel_80mm_fr_rl", glue = (-0.0806, 0.0871, 0.0167, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_right(ref = "hiwonder_mecanum_wheel_80mm_fl_rr", glue = (-0.0806, -0.0871, 0.0167, 0, -1, 0))

    Lidar lidar(ref = "hiwonder_rosorin_lidar", glue = (0.0115, 0.0001, 0.1095, 0, 0, 1))
    RGBD camera(ref = "hiwonder_rosorin_depth_camera", glue = (0.0478, 0.0001, 0.0914, 1, 0, 0))
}

// Complete declared power/control topology with a published-range alternative battery.
// Its checks state the hardware limits: the battery's 30 A peak is below what the four motors draw when they start together.
Robot strafer_arm_power {
    intent "One-arm Strafer with source-backed retention, motor controllers, USB/TTL interface and battery-fed power paths; published-range LiFePO4 battery on an authored lower cradle"

    Mecanum_four_wheel chassis(ref = "gobilda_strafer_chassis_kit_104mm")

    // The Strafer kit includes these four motors; retained 1:1 miter gears drive its wheel shafts.
    Motor motor_front_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, 0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_front, channel = "M1")
    Motor motor_front_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, -0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_front, channel = "M2")
    Motor motor_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, 0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M1")
    Motor motor_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, -0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M2")

    // A mecanum wheel has a hand: the same one goes front-left and rear-right, the other front-right and rear-left.
    Mecanum wheel_front_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_front_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (-0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (-0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))
    Mount battery_holder(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_lrl1220_battery_bridge", on = @core/chassis, at = "battery_lower_bridge", by = "top_web_holes")
    Battery battery(ref = "litech_lrl1220_lifepo4_battery", on = @core/battery_holder, at = "battery")

    Mount arm_mount(ref = "robotdsl_mount_v3_arm_strafer_omx_channel_bridge", on = @core/chassis, at = "arm_strafer_omx", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment arm(ref = "robotis_openmanipulator_x_rm_x52_tnm", on = @core/arm_mount, at = "arm_case_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/power_hub, data = @core/u2d2, port = "ttl")

// Complete nominal wiring topology; source NiMH output range is unknown, so its supply-voltage check stays undecided.
Robot strafer_arm_power_nimh {
    intent "One-arm Strafer with source-backed retention, motor controllers, USB/TTL interface and battery-fed power paths; original battery voltage envelope remains unpublished"

    Mecanum_four_wheel chassis(ref = "gobilda_strafer_chassis_kit_104mm")

    // The Strafer kit includes these four motors; retained 1:1 miter gears drive its wheel shafts.
    Motor motor_front_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, 0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_front, channel = "M1")
    Motor motor_front_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, -0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_front, channel = "M2")
    Motor motor_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, 0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M1")
    Motor motor_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, -0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M2")

    // A mecanum wheel has a hand: the same one goes front-left and rear-right, the other front-right and rear-left.
    Mecanum wheel_front_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_front_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (-0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (-0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))
    Mount battery_holder(ref = "gobilda_nested_battery_mount_1209_0001_0001", on = @core/chassis, at = "battery_rear_right", by = "mounting_holes")
    Battery battery(ref = "gobilda_nimh_battery_12v_3000mah", on = @core/battery_holder, at = "battery")

    Mount arm_mount(ref = "robotdsl_mount_v3_arm_strafer_omx_channel_bridge", on = @core/chassis, at = "arm_strafer_omx", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment arm(ref = "robotis_openmanipulator_x_rm_x52_tnm", on = @core/arm_mount, at = "arm_case_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/power_hub, data = @core/u2d2, port = "ttl")

    Mount compute_mount(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_pi5_motoron_carrier", on = @core/chassis, at = "compute_strafer_pi5", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment computer(ref = "raspberry_pi_5_8gb", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/regulator)
    MotorDriver drive_front(ref = "pololu_motoron_m2h18v20_dual_high_power_motor_controller_for_raspberry_pi_connectors_soldered", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "motoron_lower", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery, command = @core/computer, port = "i2c1", address = "0x10")
    MotorDriver drive_rear(ref = "pololu_motoron_m2h18v20_dual_high_power_motor_controller_for_raspberry_pi_connectors_soldered", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "motoron_upper", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery, command = @core/computer, port = "i2c1", address = "0x11")

    Mount regulator_mount(ref = "robotdsl_mount_strafer_d42v110f5", on = @core/chassis, at = "regulator_front_left", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment regulator(ref = "pololu_d42v110f5_5v_regulator", on = @core/regulator_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery)
    Mount hub_mount(ref = "robotdsl_mount_strafer_u2d2_power_hub", on = @core/chassis, at = "power_hub_front_right", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment power_hub(ref = "robotis_u2d2_power_hub", on = @core/hub_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery)
    Attachment u2d2(ref = "robotis_u2d2_usb_c", on = @core/power_hub, at = "u2d2_capture", by = "rivet_lips", power = @core/computer, output = "usb_power", data = @core/computer, port = "usb2_0")
}

// Complete declared power/control topology with a published-range alternative battery.
// Its checks state the hardware limits: the battery's 30 A peak is below what the four motors draw when they start together.
Robot strafer_dual_arm_power {
    intent "Two-arm Strafer with source-backed retention, motor controllers, USB/TTL interface and battery-fed power paths; published-range LiFePO4 battery on an authored lower cradle"

    Mecanum_four_wheel chassis(ref = "gobilda_strafer_chassis_kit_104mm")

    // The Strafer kit includes these four motors; retained 1:1 miter gears drive its wheel shafts.
    Motor motor_front_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, 0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_front, channel = "M1")
    Motor motor_front_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, -0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_front, channel = "M2")
    Motor motor_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, 0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M1")
    Motor motor_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, -0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M2")

    // A mecanum wheel has a hand: the same one goes front-left and rear-right, the other front-right and rear-left.
    Mecanum wheel_front_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_front_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (-0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (-0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))
    Mount battery_holder(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_lrl1220_battery_bridge", on = @core/chassis, at = "battery_lower_bridge", by = "top_web_holes")
    Battery battery(ref = "litech_lrl1220_lifepo4_battery", on = @core/battery_holder, at = "battery")

    Mount arm_mount_left(ref = "robotdsl_mount_strafer_omx_pair_bridge", on = @core/chassis, at = "arm_strafer_omx_left", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment arm_left(ref = "robotis_openmanipulator_x_rm_x52_tnm", on = @core/arm_mount_left, at = "arm_case_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/power_hub, data = @core/u2d2, port = "ttl")
    Mount arm_mount_right(ref = "robotdsl_mount_strafer_omx_pair_bridge", on = @core/chassis, at = "arm_strafer_omx_right", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment arm_right(ref = "robotis_openmanipulator_x_rm_x52_tnm", on = @core/arm_mount_right, at = "arm_case_holes_rearward", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/power_hub, data = @core/u2d2, port = "ttl")

    Mount compute_mount(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_pi5_motoron_carrier", on = @core/chassis, at = "compute_strafer_pi5", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment computer(ref = "raspberry_pi_5_8gb", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/regulator)
    MotorDriver drive_front(ref = "pololu_motoron_m2h18v20_dual_high_power_motor_controller_for_raspberry_pi_connectors_soldered", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "motoron_lower", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery, command = @core/computer, port = "i2c1", address = "0x10")
    MotorDriver drive_rear(ref = "pololu_motoron_m2h18v20_dual_high_power_motor_controller_for_raspberry_pi_connectors_soldered", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "motoron_upper", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery, command = @core/computer, port = "i2c1", address = "0x11")

    Mount regulator_mount(ref = "robotdsl_mount_strafer_d42v110f5", on = @core/chassis, at = "regulator_front_left", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment regulator(ref = "pololu_d42v110f5_5v_regulator", on = @core/regulator_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery)
    Mount hub_mount(ref = "robotdsl_mount_strafer_u2d2_power_hub", on = @core/chassis, at = "power_hub_front_right", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment power_hub(ref = "robotis_u2d2_power_hub", on = @core/hub_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery)
    Attachment u2d2(ref = "robotis_u2d2_usb_c", on = @core/power_hub, at = "u2d2_capture", by = "rivet_lips", power = @core/computer, output = "usb_power", data = @core/computer, port = "usb2_0")
}

// A Strafer that sees and thinks: a Unitree L2 lidar on the middle channel, an OAK-D Lite depth camera on the
// front one, an inertial unit beside it, and a Raspberry Pi 5 on the rear of the left rail.
Robot strafer_lidar {
    intent "goBILDA Strafer mecanum base carrying a Unitree 4D LiDAR L2, a Luxonis OAK-D Lite, a MinIMU-9 and a Raspberry Pi 5"

    Mecanum_four_wheel chassis(ref = "gobilda_strafer_chassis_kit_104mm")

    // The Strafer kit includes these four motors; retained 1:1 miter gears drive its wheel shafts.
    Motor motor_front_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, 0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0))
    Motor motor_front_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, -0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0))
    Motor motor_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, 0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0))
    Motor motor_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, -0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0))

    Mecanum wheel_front_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_front_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (-0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (-0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))

    Lidar3D lidar(ref = "unitree_4d_lidar_l2", glue = (0, 0, 0.024, 0, 0, 1))
    RGBD camera(ref = "luxonis_oak_d_lite", glue = (0.168, 0, 0.024, 0, 0, 1))
    IMU imu(ref = "pololu_minimu_9_v6", glue = (0.084, 0.156, 0.024, 0, 0, 1))
    Attachment computer(ref = "raspberry_pi_5_8gb", glue = (-0.168, 0.156, 0.024, 0, 0, 1))
}
